P0.name: Natural Baseline
P0.description: Hold until natural opposite V_A regime flip under baseline contract. Control policy.

P1.name: Immediate Q4 Exit
P1.description: Exit immediately at the first causally observed observation in Q4 (H1 >= 0.50 and H2 >= 0.25).

P2.name: Q4 + 60s Continuous Persistence
P2.description: First Q4 entry arms invalidation watch. Exit only when Q4 remains continuously active for >= 60 seconds. Reset on drop below threshold. Natural flip fallback.

P3.name: Q4 + 60s Persistence + Recovery Cancellation
P3.description: Q4 arms watch; exit at >= 60s continuous Q4. If running_peak_hazard - current_hazard >= 0.15 before 60s, disarm watch and reset clock. Natural flip fallback.

P4.name: Staged H1 -> H2 Confirmation
P4.rationale: Omitted per instruction as parent contracts did not define unambiguous frozen thresholds.
